announcement: Your next Singapore adventure starts here · Enquire on Telegram
heroText: Movie nights, wildlife encounters and a little island adventure. Find your next day out, then chat with Jason for the latest ticket rates.
notice: Prices and availability are confirmed on Telegram. Ask about your preferred date, ticket type and any booking requirements before paying.

products.name: Golden Village
products.subtitle: All Day movie tickets
products.description: Make it a movie night. Ask Jason about Golden Village All Day tickets for your next cinema visit.
products.terms: Confirm eligible cinemas, screenings, redemption steps, expiry and any surcharges on Telegram.
products.sourceTerms: Klook’s EVERYDAY voucher is online-only on GV’s website/iGV. Valid 90 days; non-refundable. A S$2.50 online transaction fee applies. Premium formats/seating, group bookings, festivals, premieres and marathons are excluded. Christmas and New Year eves/days, Lunar New Year eve/first two days and their replacement holidays are excluded. If Movie e-Voucher is unavailable for a screening, it is ineligible. Your All Day voucher may have different conditions: confirm the actual voucher with Jason.

products.name: Singapore Zoo
products.subtitle: A day on the wild side
products.description: A day out for animal lovers. Enquire about Singapore Zoo tickets and plan your visit with family or friends.
products.terms: Confirm ticket eligibility, visit date, child age bands and whether tram access is included.
products.sourceTerms: Klook lists these packages as non-refundable. Children aged 0–2 enter free. Open-date tickets need Mandai reservations at least one day ahead; reserved dates are final. Fixed-date tickets need no separate reservation. Tram access is included only where specified. Tours/dining below exclude admission. Klook’s Mandai tickets prohibit resale; entry may be refused without compensation. Reference choices only.

products.terms: Confirm visit date, ticket eligibility and any ride, height, age or operational restrictions.
products.sourceTerms: Klook lists non-refundable packages, including bad-weather visits. Standard admission is for one guest; children aged 0–3 enter free. faqs.question: How do I order tickets?
faqs.answer: Choose a ticket and send your preferred date and group size to @jasonjwkk on Telegram. Jason will confirm the available rate, ticket details and next steps.

faqs.question: Why do the tickets say ‘Enquire for price’?
faqs.answer: Ticket rates and availability can vary. Message Jason on Telegram to confirm the current price for your date and ticket type.

faqs.question: What should I check before paying?
faqs.answer: Confirm the attraction, visit date, ticket eligibility, expiry, inclusions, redemption instructions and cancellation terms directly with Jason.

faqs.question: Where can I view your Carousell profile?
faqs.answer: Use the Carousell links on this page to visit voucherlobangking, see the current listings and read feedback there.

faqs.question: How are payment and ticket delivery arranged?
faqs.answer: Jason will explain the available payment methods and ticket delivery details on Telegram before you confirm your order.

faqs.question: Are the Klook reference options available from Jason?
faqs.answer: The options and terms summarise the linked Klook listings checked on 11 October 2026. They help you describe your enquiry; they are not a guarantee of seller availability. Klook promotions, refunds and validity rules do not automatically apply to Jason’s tickets. Confirm your actual ticket’s source, eligibility, inclusions and terms before paying.
